stateDiagram-v2 direction TB state "order" as order { direction TB [*] --> order_placed state "placed" as order_placed state "paid" as order_paid state "packingLate" as order_packingLate state "packed" as order_packed order_packed : invoke shipOrder state "shippingFailed" as order_shippingFailed state "shipped" as order_shipped state "cancelled" as order_cancelled } order_placed --> order_paid : PAY if hasTotal
recordPayment order_placed --> order_cancelled : PAYMENT_FAILED
recordPaymentFailure order_placed --> order_cancelled : CANCEL order_paid --> order_packed : PACKED order_paid --> order_cancelled : CANCEL order_paid --> order_packingLate : after 60000 ms order_packingLate --> order_packed : PACKED order_packingLate --> order_cancelled : CANCEL order_packed --> order_shipped : done: shipOrder
storeTracking order_packed --> order_shippingFailed : error: shipOrder order_shippingFailed --> order_cancelled : CANCEL

ff87ee3591.title: checkout
ff87ee3591.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2 direction TB state "checkout" as checkout { direction TB [*] --> checkout_cart state "cart" as checkout_cart state "shipping" as checkout_shipping state "payment" as checkout_payment state "processing" as checkout_processing state "confirmed" as checkout_confirmed } checkout_cart --> checkout_shipping : PROCEED checkout_shipping --> checkout_payment : CONFIRM_ADDRESS checkout_payment --> checkout_processing : PAY
startPayment checkout_processing --> checkout_confirmed : SUCCESS checkout_processing --> checkout_payment : FAILURE
